Type: shelf
Name: AmazonBasics Wall Mounted Standard Coat Rack, 8 Hooks, Set of 2, Natural (Renewed)
Colors: Natural
2 pack of wall-mountable coat rack with wood base and 8 standard double metal hooks Perfect for organization and storage of coats, clothing items, scarves, towels, pet leashes, and more Space-saving design is a convenient alternative to free-standing racks Durable metal double hooks hold up to 5 pounds of weight each Wood base mounts flush to any wall in your entryway, bedroom, closet, bathroom, and more Available in a variety of sizes and finishes
